about: Nemotron-H (the Omni checkpoint's language model), every tensor in its source dtype from the HF BF16 checkpoint (bf16; the router's selection bias f32): the BF16 reference container. The drafter (MTP) is written; the vision tower is consumed by name (v1: text only). Fits any Nemotron-H Omni checkpoint (the 5-block mini and Nemotron 3.5 Super VL).
